method: Independent verification of each claim against the cited source URL only. No research notes, transcripts, or builder reasoning were seen. Pages fetched live on 2026-09-17 (06:52-07:05 EDT).
note_on_model_family: This review is fresh-context evidence-only. A cross-model-family review was not available in this runtime; the control applied is strict context separation (claim packet + source URLs only, never the builder's notes).
policy_reasoning: The reach floor is >=10,000 and 209k (=209,000) clears it ~20x. The figure is creator-attested on her own official page (single consistent source), not conflicting third-party estimates — materially stronger than the evidence that drew the earlier quarantine (87.1K vs 81.8K vs 82.5K from three third parties). The dataset's own convention records cited K-figures (e.g. existing '234K' rows). An exact integer is unachievable for ANY Instagram creator without login: Instagram login-walls anonymous profile reads and every secondary source rounds. Holding (b) would make the slot permanently unfillable without a login the project treats as last resort. Recording '209K' records exactly what was cited — no integer invented, unknowns-stay-unknown rule intact. Independent corroboration (Jupiter Magazine: 'more than 200,000 followers') is consistent, not conflicting.

verdicts.sufficiency_note: Instagram's anonymous /embed/captioned/ endpoint was checked directly (HTTP 200, 273KB) and no longer exposes any absolute post timestamp (no datetime=, taken_at, or time tags in HTML). The (relative label + fetch date) bound is therefore the best available evidence without login. It is first-party and creator-attributable (her own site's WPZoom feed of her own IG account), not a third-party estimate. Even allowing +/-1 day for relative-date rounding, no plausible reading places any item before 2026-06-18. Judged SUFFICIENT.
